title: How Roger Leer began removing alien implants
summary: Steve Coburn tells of How Roger Leer began removing alien implants, about c. 1990s-2010s at Thousand Oaks, California, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, he was a podiatrist and uh he was always interested in UFOs. He was um the most knowledgeable euphologist I've ever met. And um he um was at a UFO conference once and um uh Daryl Sims tried to get him interested in alien implants.

plain: Steve Coburn, a scientist who studies what are called alien implants (small objects some people believe were put into their bodies by non-human beings), tells how a foot doctor named Roger Leer got into the field. Coburn says Leer, based in Thousand Oaks, California, was the most knowledgeable UFO researcher he ever met, and that at a UFO conference a man named Daryl Sims tried to interest him in these implants, which led Leer to start removing them from people from around the 1990s on.
